answer: A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the nectar graph. Re-attestations are stored in crystal and saffron lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 2 peers re-attest it every 14 epochs, so holding a position demands ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 943 impostors cost 182 times the honest price and take 29 times as long to clear. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
